audit_findings_remediated.description: Silent fallback to debug keystore in release build type
audit_findings_remediated.resolution: Removed debug keystore fallback. Release builds without UB_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_* are unsigned (signingConfig = null). CI release workflow fails closed on missing secrets.

audit_findings_remediated.description: Forwarding thread pool saturation (4 workers, 64 queue) causing 59%+ timeouts on 10 concurrent threads
audit_findings_remediated.resolution: Expanded thread pool to bounded dynamic sizing (8-16 core, 16-32 max, 256 queue) with idle thread timeout and synchronized TUN writer queue (256 capacity).

audit_findings_remediated.description: Excessive cold DNS resolution cascade latency (up to 2700ms on dead upstream)
audit_findings_remediated.resolution: Reduced UDP timeout to 500ms and TCP timeouts to 750ms, eliminating 1450ms from dead resolver cascades while preserving RFC 5452 anti-spoofing and packet validation.

audit_findings_remediated.description: Doze mode socket suspension on Android 14+ background execution
audit_findings_remediated.resolution: Added android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS to manifest and documented user exemption guidance.

signing_verification.release_unsigned_verification: DOES NOT VERIFY - Missing META-INF/MANIFEST.MF (no debug certificate fallback)
signing_verification.releaseTest_verification: Verified using v2 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v2) with test keystore
signing_verification.ci_policy_enforcement: Fail-closed in scripts/release-policy.py when UB_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_* missing
